item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The figure shows Sonia's bar graph of library books borrowed in three categories. The vertical scale uses equal intervals.

Which category has the greatest number of books?

options.A: Science, because its bar is tallest on the equal-interval scale.
options.B: Comics, because the category name alone settles the book count.
options.C: Fiction, as if equal intervals on the vertical scale are not required.
options.D: Science, because darker shading settles the book count.
